content.title: How to watch The Masters 2026 for FREE: live stream final round from anywhere
content.text: The Sunday of the 2026 Masters could deliver one of the best final rounds in living memory.We have a star-studded line-up at the top of the leaderboard with Rory McIlroy, Cam Young, Justin Rose and Scottie Scheffler all still in contention. Don't pay for a subscription just yet though: Masters.com are streaming the action for free in the US — find out more below. How to watch The Masters 2026 final round for FREE But, free coverage is only available to those with a US IP address. If you're abroad right now you will need a VPN to access the free stream. How to watch The Masters 2026 free from anywhere Away from home at the moment and blocked from watching premium golf action on your usual subscription?You can still tune into The Masters 2026 live thanks to the wonders of a VPN (Virtual Private Network). The software allows your devices to appear as if they're back in your home country regardless of where in the world you are. So ideal for viewers away on vacation or on business. Our favorite is NordVPN. It's the best on the market: Using a VPN is incredibly simple.1. Install the VPN of your choice. As we've said, NordVPN is our favorite.2. Choose the location you wish to connect to in the VPN app. For instance, if you're in Canada and want watch the Masters 2026 for free, you'd select 'United States' from the server list.3. Sit back and enjoy the action. Head to Masters.com or the Masters app and tune into the 2026 tournament for free.
